patterns.note: Full-width sections with alternating background colors (white, light grey, dark green, light green) contain centrally aligned, constrained-width content blocks.
Prominent, bold, sans-serif headings (Graphik) are consistently used for section titles and key statements, paired with a more neutral, readable sans-serif for body text (Roboto).
A vibrant, almost neon green (#228800) serves as the primary accent and CTA color, providing high contrast against a clean palette of black, white, and various shades of grey.
Sections and individual content blocks (like cards or statistics) reveal with a subtle fade-up or slide-up animation as they scroll into the viewport.
The main navigation bar transitions from a transparent overlay over the hero video to a solid, slightly condensed white bar with a subtle shadow upon scrolling down the page.
Distinct content sections are visually separated by full-width background color changes, often featuring large, impactful imagery or statistics to break up information.

technique_notes: The hero section features a full-bleed background video that plays automatically, overlaid with a dark gradient to ensure text readability.

Content sections are revealed using scroll-triggered animations, where elements like text blocks, images, and cards subtly fade and slide upwards into their final positions as the user scrolls them into view.

The global navigation bar employs a sticky behavior, initially appearing transparent and full-height over the hero, then shrinking in height and gaining a solid white background and shadow as the user scrolls down the page.

design_tokens.type_scale: Bold, impactful sans-serif headings (Graphik) are significantly larger than the clean, readable sans-serif body text (Roboto), creating a strong visual hierarchy.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounding (small radius) on interactive elements, buttons, and cards, maintaining a modern and approachable feel.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced and airy, with generous vertical spacing between sections and within content blocks, ensuring readability and visual breathing room.

standout: The site effectively uses a vibrant, almost neon green as a powerful brand accent, consistently applied to CTAs, icons, and key visual elements, making the brand feel energetic and modern. This, combined with the bold, clean typography and dynamic scroll-triggered reveals, creates a highly engaging and professional user experience that avoids feeling generic.
